caseName: Superior Court of California v. Evans
caseNameFull: Superior Court of California, in and for the City and County of San Francisco v. Evans, Building and Loan Commissioner
attorneys: Messrs. Wm. M. Cannon and W. H. Orrick for appellants., Messrs. O. K. Cushing, Charles S. Cushing, Everett S. Layman, and Bartley C. Crum for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is .dismissed for the want of a properly presented federal question. Godchaux Co. v. Estopinal, 251 U. S. 179; Rooker v. Fidelity Trust Co., 261 U. S. 114, 117; Herndon v. Georgia, 295 U. S. 441, 443.
